[package]
name = "uniffi"
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"

[dependencies.uniffi_bindgen]
path = "../uniffi_bindgen"
version = "=0.27.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.uniffi_build]
path = "../uniffi_build"
version = "=0.27.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.uniffi_core]
path = "../uniffi_core"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.uniffi_macros]
path = "../uniffi_macros"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.camino]
version = "1.0.8"
optional = true

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4"
features = ["cargo", "std", "derive"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
trybuild = "1"

[features]
default = []
build = ["dep:uniffi_build"]
bindgen = ["dep:uniffi_bindgen"]
cli = ["bindgen", "dep:clap", "dep:camino"]
bindgen-tests = ["dep:uniffi_bindgen"]
tokio = ["uniffi_core/tokio"]
scaffolding-ffi-buffer-fns = ["uniffi_core/scaffolding-ffi-buffer-fns", "uniffi_macros/scaffolding-ffi-buffer-fns"]

[package]
name = "uniffi_bindgen"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (codegen and cli tooling)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
camino = "1.0.8"
cargo_metadata = "0.15"
fs-err = "2.7.0"
glob = "0.3"
goblin = "0.8"
heck = "0.5"
once_cell = "1.12"
paste = "1.0"
toml = "0.5"

[dependencies.askama]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["config"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.uniffi_meta]
path = "../uniffi_meta"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.uniffi_testing]
path = "../uniffi_testing"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.uniffi_udl]
path = "../uniffi_udl"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.textwrap]
version = "0.16"
features = ["smawk"]
default-features = false

[package]
name = "uniffi_build"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (build script helpers)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
camino = "1.0.8"

[dependencies.uniffi_bindgen]
path = "../uniffi_bindgen"
default-features = false
version = "=0.27.1"

[features]
default = []
builtin-bindgen = []

[package]
name = "uniffi_checksum_derive"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (checksum custom derive)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1.0"

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0"
features = ["derive", "parsing"]

[features]
default = []
nightly = []

[package]
name = "uniffi_core"
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (runtime support code)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
bytes = "1.3"
camino = "1.0.8"
log = "0.4"
once_cell = "1.10.0"
paste = "1.0"
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[dependencies.async-compat]
version = "0.2.1"
optional = true

[features]
default = []
tokio = ["dep:async-compat"]
scaffolding-ffi-buffer-fns = []

[package]
name = "uniffi_macros"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (convenience macros)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
bincode = "1.3"
camino = "1.0.8"
fs-err = "2.7.0"
once_cell = "1.10.0"
proc-macro2 = "1.0"
quote = "1.0"
toml = "0.5.9"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.136"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2.0"
features = ["full", "visit-mut"]

[dependencies.uniffi_build]
path = "../uniffi_build"
version = "=0.27.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.uniffi_meta]
path = "../uniffi_meta"
version = "=0.27.1"

[features]
default = []
trybuild = ["dep:uniffi_build"]
scaffolding-ffi-buffer-fns = []
nightly = []

[package]
name = "uniffi_meta"
version = "0.27.1"
edition = "2021"
description = "uniffi_meta"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
bytes = "1.3"
siphasher = "0.3"

[dependencies.uniffi_checksum_derive]
version = "0.27.1"
path = "../uniffi_checksum_derive"

[package]
name = "uniffi_testing"
version = "0.27.1"
authors = ["Firefox Sync Team <sync-team@mozilla.com>"]
description = "a multi-language bindings generator for rust (testing helpers)"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
edition = "2021"
license = "MPL-2.0"
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
camino = "1.0.8"
cargo_metadata = "0.15"
fs-err = "2.7.0"
once_cell = "1.12"

[package]
name = "uniffi_udl"
version = "0.27.1"
description = "udl parsing for the uniffi project"
documentation = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
homepage = "https://mozilla.github.io/uniffi-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
license = "MPL-2.0"
edition = "2021"
keywords = ["ffi", "bindgen"]
readme = "../README.md"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"

[dependencies.weedle2]
version = "5.0.0"
path = "../weedle2"

[dependencies.textwrap]
version = "0.16"
features = ["smawk"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.uniffi_meta]
path = "../uniffi_meta"
version = "=0.27.1"

[dependencies.uniffi_testing]
path = "../uniffi_testing"
version = "=0.27.1"

[package]
name = "weedle2"
version = "5.0.0"
authors = ["Sharad Chand <sharad.d.chand@gmail.com>", "Jan-Erik Rediger <jrediger@mozilla.com>"]
description = "A WebIDL Parser"
license = "MIT"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/weedle2"
homepage = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs/tree/main/weedle2"
repository = "https://github.com/mozilla/uniffi-rs"
readme = "README.md"
edition = "2021"
exclude = ["tests"]

[lib]
name = "weedle"

[dependencies]
nom = "7.1.0"

[dev-dependencies]
fs-err = "2.7.0"
